title: 2026-11-13 · Should personal work live apart from the open-source repo?
description: Decision: a sibling workspace beside the public repo, as Tinka does, rather than a private copy with a push-to-public rule. November 14, 2026: the migration plan was accepted and approved; steps S1 to S9 are done and both repositories are clean. Pending: the live fresh-session trials (S10); host settings for sibling access unverified until then. Markdown report and an 8-page telling. Facts, decisions and open items labelled.

build.message: November 14: S1 to S9 done; live trials pending.
